# vvm_action_invocation (Data Source)

Reads the result of a VVM action invocation by ID. The action must have been triggered elsewhere (e.g. via the VVM CLI or another Terraform resource). This data source is read-only.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The action invocation ID (Idempotency-Key / request_id).

### Read-Only

- `activity_tracker_event_ids` (List of String) IBM Cloud Activity Tracker event IDs emitted during the action.
- `actor` (String) Identity of the principal that triggered the action.
- `affected_host_ids` (List of String) UUIDs of hosts that were affected by the action.
- `affected_vm_ids` (List of String) UUIDs of VMs that were affected by the action.
- `finished_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the action finished. Empty if still in progress.
- `started_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the action started.
- `status` (String) Current status of the action: `pending`, `running`, `succeeded`, or `failed`.
- `summary` (Map of String) Key-value pairs summarising the action outcome (e.g. `probe_ok`).
